reviews.title: Disabled functionality
reviews.text: I used to use this app regularly for years. It had the ability to do odd tunings or different tunings, drop tuning, etc.. All for free. Then one day they decided they were going to charge for alternate tuning and I said goodbye. A tuner is not exactly a high-level application. There are plenty of free tuning apps out there. So sorry, Fender I will no longer have your brand permanently displayed on my iPhone.

reviews.title: Another trash tuning app
reviews.text: Everything costs money that I don’t have, so I thought how nice is it that fender has an app with a free tuning feature? I don’t have the money to buy a tuner right now, thank god for them. Except this trash app doesn’t even work. It can’t figure out what cord I’m plucking and violently bounces between chords. I’m scared the string is going to break while I’m doing it because that’s how much back and forth BS is happening. I’m over it. Nothing I do to correct it works. This thing is so garbage I wouldn’t even wipe with it. A grand waste of time this was.

reviews.title: Please add selective string to tune. broken strings before
reviews.text: The most annoying part about this tuner is that the app automatically chooses what string to select off the sound of your guitar. A way better feature would be to just stay at one string that you choose with the same system. Instead the app is constantly switching between string and string which makes tuning very frustrating. Also a side note when i try to tune to B Standard, the F# is for some reason extremely high pitched to the point where it has snapped my strings. This may be user error but im not sure.
